name: Apply for SNAP, cash or child care help
description: The state's online form for SNAP food help, cash help, and help paying for child care.

organization.name: Ohio Department of Job and Family Services

eligibility: There are rules about income and who lives with you. Most students who take six or more credits also need to meet one extra rule, like working 20 hours a week.

steps: Complete the interview when the county calls.
Send any verification they ask for.
documents: Proof of income for the last 30 days
Proof of the student exemption (work schedule, work-study award, or child care need)
